name: Hoki Temple Gold
summary: Light ground #f6f2eb, yellow accent #8a6418, Iowan Old Style over system-ui, with a dark set.
note: Soft paper, rounded cards and temple gold; the illustration colours come along as extras.

fonts.display: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Noto Serif", "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", SimSun, Georgia, serif
fonts.body: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

light.accent: curated: --gold-ink is the gold that passes as text on paper; --gold (#d9a441) is the fill and the dark-mode accent
light.accent_ink: derived: best contrast on the accent out of white, ink and bg
